taskVersion.name: ves-synthetic-b-item

parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station T-25 (survey area T). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 92.8 | 5.24 | 5.24
2 | 69.4 | 6.10 | 11.34
3 | 27.8 | 5.66 | 17.00
4 | 47.2 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this sounding curve as QH-type.

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: T-25
Curve type: QH-type
Aquifer depth: 11.34 - 17.00 m
Recommendation: Target the low-resistivity zone identified between 11.34 m and 17.00 m. Ensure the well screen is positioned within this specific interval to optimize water yield.
